sam: Quick plan 10s: pilot a 'first-success velocity' experiment to see which onboarding nudges shorten time-to-first-success and improve prompt reuse. three arms: (A) in-email prompt snippets + 40 credits on first success, (B) in-product checklist + no credits but immediate sample prompt prefilled, (C) webinar RSVP + 80 credits delivered after attendee completes a 2-step post-webinar task. target: reduce median time_to_first_success from ~36h to <24h and lift 7d prompt_reuse. budget $1.2k. who owns routing & tagging?

elena: i'll own creative. i'll make 3 subject lines and short in-product copy for the sample prompt card. ETA Wed EOD. also want a tiny A/B on two subject line hooks.

ricardo: infra note: randomize at signup, persist assignment. grant-on-first-success for credit arms. whitelist corporate emails only. growth-bot can you create experiment and enforce caps?

growth-bot: experiment created: id fs-2026-11-01-velocity. assignment: randomized at signup, saved to user.experiments.fs_velocity. grants trigger on event:first_success for arms with credits. per-user cap settable. doc: https://redwood.internal/experiments/fs-2026-11-01-velocity

maria: analytics ask: tag each user with experiment_id and arm_name, record first_success_ts, prompt_id_used, prompt_use_count, webinar_attended boolean, and referral_source. i'll run median time_to_first_success and prompt_reuse_rate.

elena: creative flow: immediate email with either snippet or checklist link, in-product card that surfaces the sample prompt after signup but only activates after first_success for the credit arms. social teaser day-before webinar.

ricardo: ops constraints: global spend cap $1.2k, per-user cap 80 credits, expire credits after 14 days, grant only once. sample grant payload: ```json
{"experiment_id":"fs-2026-11-01-velocity","arm":"credits_email","credits":40,"cap_per_user":80}
```

data-lab: ramp plan: start with 180 randomized users Mon 09:00 UTC, monitor budget burn; alert to #marketing-ops if spend > $300 in first 24h. we'll exclude internal/test accounts from analysis.

maria: measurement note: median time will be computed in hours from signup_ts to first_success_ts; prompt_reuse = same prompt_id used >=2x within 7d. will publish interim results after 72h.

elena: posting creative + subject lines in #marketing in 2h. pls react with :eyes:.

sam: final checklist: creative Wed EOD, routing + experiment infra Fri noon, analytics tags live before launch. launch Monday AM if green. keep updates here and flag blockers. :rocket:
